title: Back to the trains: Christmas card and the apartment party
summary: They don't wear uniforms while working on the trains; they sent a Christmas card, and she recalls a party where the apartment was turned into a saloon. The interviewer ends the recording.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: Did we ask you about that? Back to the trains. When they work on the trains, do they wear the uniforms of the people? Oh no.
Yes. They sent a very nice Christmas card
showing a train, you know, with Atlan and his family and Merlin on the other side.

But they love the Reconstitution because the night of the 1st of July, we had a wake up with them and we were about a dozen. And they had transformed the apartment into a loon. And it's extraordinary because there were all the pictures on the walls. Wanted. Reward. The buffet of the dining room was covered with paper in a marble. It was a bar. They had absolutely demolished the whole apartment and Merlin had all decorated in a salon.
Well, maybe we should turn it off. I'll get it.
